record.title: Extend the ladder to level 268 with side stubs the explorer does not pay for
record.description: The owner saw that the menu maze for level 18000 looks like a level 30 maze. Every level from 198 was the same maze class because the ladder steers on one explorer number and the board is full at level 198. The new pull request adds exactly one more cell of short side stubs per level (the explorer does not enter stubs of 3 cells or fewer), which keeps the explorer number fixed and strictly orders levels 199 to 268 by cell count. Checked only in headless Chromium, not on a real phone.

PR #416 (merge a983f2de) places images on whole pixels, sets the camera origin to 0,0 and snaps the bake margins and maze origin to whole pixels. Merged and deployed to production (Ready, live bundle verified to contain the new code). Checked only in headless Chromium at several viewport sizes and pixel ratios, not on a real phone or an installed app.
